title: Pet Antibacterial Tooth Cleaning Cap

Lurson Pet Dental Finger Pads | Gentle Teeth & Gum Cleaning for Dogs & Cats | No Toothpaste Needed | 40 PCS

  • Gentle dental finger pads for dogs and cats, designed for easy teeth and gum cleaning without toothpaste
  • Soft and non-irritating texture to gently wipe away plaque, debris and food residue from pet's mouth
  • Convenient disposable design, easy to use and ideal for daily pet oral care routine
  • Suitable for all breeds and sizes, gentle enough for sensitive pet gums
  • 40 pads per container, provides long-lasting daily oral care for your pet
